_comment: Example house rules for the article checker, using the placeholder organization example.org.
Copy this file, change the values to your own site, and run: python3 scripts/validate_article.py draft.md --brand-rules my-rules.json
Leave a list empty ([]) or a patterns object empty ({}) to switch that check off. Every key below must stay in the file.
cms_template_checks: set to true only if every post on your site starts with a metadata table and has a Key Takeaways box.
